checks.ref:
command:set -e
if [ -z "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  echo "GH_TOKEN is absent from the check environment - .gnomish/factory/gnomish exports it from the secrets folder and project.yaml passes it through factory.sandbox.env-passthrough; without it no gh call in this stage can work"
  exit 1
fi
repo=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*repo:[[:space:]]*//p' .gnomish/config.yaml | head -1)
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
base=$(gh pr list --repo "$repo" --head "$branch" --state open --json baseRefName --jq '.[0].baseRefName // empty')
if [ -z "$base" ]; then
  echo "no open pull request for branch $branch in $repo - open one with: gh pr create --repo $repo --base main --head $branch --title <title> --body-file pr-body.md"
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$base" != "main" ]; then
  echo "the pull request for $branch targets $base, not main - retarget it with: gh pr edit --repo $repo --base main"
  exit 1
fi

command:set -e
repo=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*repo:[[:space:]]*//p' .gnomish/config.yaml | head -1)
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
number=$(gh pr list --repo "$repo" --head "$branch" --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
if [ ! -f pr-body.md ]; then
  echo "pr-body.md is missing - the stage must leave the published body in that file, it is the only thing the checks can read"
  exit 1
fi
title=$(gh pr view "$number" --repo "$repo" --json title --jq .title)
case "$title" in
  gnomish:*|"") echo "the pull request title is '$title' - give it a real one describing the change, not a factory commit subject"; exit 1 ;;
esac
if [ ${#title} -lt 10 ]; then
  echo "the pull request title '$title' is too short to describe the change"
  exit 1
fi
local_body=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < pr-body.md)
remote_body=$(gh pr view "$number" --repo "$repo" --json body --jq .body | tr -d '[:space:]')
if [ ${#local_body} -lt 120 ]; then
  echo "pr-body.md holds ${#local_body} non-whitespace characters - too thin for a reviewer; describe what changed, why, and how it was verified"
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$local_body" != "$remote_body" ]; then
  echo "the published body and pr-body.md differ - publish the file itself: gh pr edit $number --repo $repo --body-file pr-body.md"
  exit 1
fi
issue=$(sed -n 's/.*"taskId":"[^"#]*#\([0-9][0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' .gnomish-task/task.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -n "$issue" ] && ! grep -q "#$issue" pr-body.md; then
  echo "the body never references the task issue - add a 'Refs #$issue' line so the reviewer can find it"
  exit 1
fi

command:since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^deliver#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
dirty=$(git status --porcelain | grep -v ' \.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$dirty" ] || { echo "$dirty"; echo "the deliver stage writes only pr-body.md - restore the files above with: git checkout -- <file>"; exit 1; }
commits=$(git log --format='%h %s' "$since"..HEAD | grep -v ' gnomish: ' || true)
[ -z "$commits" ] || { echo "$commits"; echo "the deliver stage commits nothing - the commits above must not be on the task branch"; exit 1; }

command:set -e
archive=$(grep -oE 'openspec/changes/archive/[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[a-z0-9-]+' pr-body.md | head -1 || true)
[ -n "$archive" ] || { echo "the body never names the archived change - point at openspec/changes/archive/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD-<change>/"; exit 1; }
[ -d "$archive" ] || { echo "the body points at $archive, which does not exist - name the directory the archive stage created"; exit 1; }
if grep -qiE '(close[sd]?|fix(e[sd])?|resolve[sd]?):? #[0-9]' pr-body.md; then
  echo "the body closes an issue - this project closes its own issues, use 'Refs #<issue>'"; exit 1
fi
requirement_ids() { grep -oE '\b(FR|UX|M|G|NG)-?[0-9]+\b|\bNFR-[A-Z]+[0-9]+\b' "$1" | sed -E 's/^(FR|UX|M|G|NG)-/\1/' | sort -u; }
body_ids=$(requirement_ids pr-body.md || true)
[ -n "$body_ids" ] || { echo "the body names no requirement ids - list the ones the change implements from $archive/proposal.md"; exit 1; }
proposal_ids=$(requirement_ids "$archive/proposal.md" || true)
unknown_ids=$(for id in $body_ids; do printf '%s\n' "$proposal_ids" | grep -qxF "$id" || echo "$id"; done)
[ -z "$unknown_ids" ] || { echo "$unknown_ids"; echo "the body names the ids above, which $archive/proposal.md does not define - use the proposal's own ids"; exit 1; }
test_files=$(grep -oE '[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.(feature|test\.tsx?)' pr-body.md | sed 's|^packages/client/src/||' | sort -u || true)
[ -n "$test_files" ] || { echo "the body names no .feature or test files - say which ones under packages/client/src/ cover the change"; exit 1; }
missing_files=$(printf '%s\n' "$test_files" | while read -r name; do [ -n "$(find packages/client/src -path "*/$name" -print -quit)" ] || echo "$name"; done)
[ -z "$missing_files" ] || { echo "$missing_files"; echo "the body names the files above, and none exists under packages/client/src/ - name the real ones"; exit 1; }
# The reports are gone from the working copy since cleanup; they are read from the commit
# that removed them, one before it.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
reports=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
removed_in=$(git log -1 --format=%H --diff-filter=D -- "$reports" || true)
for review in review-specs.md review-code.md; do
  [ -n "$removed_in" ] && report=$(git show "$removed_in^:$reports/$review" 2>/dev/null) || continue
  grep -qF "$review" pr-body.md || { echo "the body never summarises $review - give its fixed and rejected counts"; exit 1; }
  for finding in $(printf '%s\n' "$report" | awk '/^### /{ finding = $2 } /^- Status: rejected/{ print finding }'); do
    grep -qw "$finding" pr-body.md || { echo "$review rejects $finding, and the body never names it - list every rejected finding with its reason"; exit 1; }
  done
done
# Every handoff item reaches the human: its id in the body, and each patch by its file name
# (the apply command and the diff block name it).
if [ -n "$removed_in" ] && handoff=$(git show "$removed_in^:$reports/handoff/README.md" 2>/dev/null); then
  for item in $(printf '%s\n' "$handoff" | sed -n 's/^## \(H[0-9][0-9]*\):.*/\1/p'); do
    grep -qw "$item" pr-body.md || { echo "the handoff README lists $item, and the body never names it - put every item into the Human follow-up section"; exit 1; }
  done
  for patch in $(git ls-tree --name-only "$removed_in^" "$reports/handoff/" | grep '\.patch$'); do
    grep -qF "$(basename "$patch")" pr-body.md || { echo "the body never gives $(basename "$patch") - add its diff block and its apply command"; exit 1; }
  done
fi
